label: FP
reason: User input flows through param -> Base64 encode/decode -> bar, but bar is never used in the response output. The response writes rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue() which are derived from server-generated cookieName (from class name) and rememberMeKey (from SecureRandom), not from user-provided param.

evidence.note: param set from request parameter name when value matches BenchmarkTest00580
bar receives encoded/decoded param but is unused in response
response outputs cookieName and rememberMeKey which are server-generated, not user-controlled
